inline_text:
Please consider updates to two names before D4 and D6 are drafted.

- **"Conformance" (D6: "self-assessment guidance, conformance validation artifacts, and pass/fail tests").** Under the EU AI Act, "conformity assessment" (Article 43) is a defined procedure with a defined outcome, and a document called "Evaluation and Conformance Guidance" from a foundation working group will be read as it. "Conformance to this vocabulary" or "consistency checks" would be better.

- **"Quality thresholds" (D4).** Article 15(1) requires "an appropriate level of accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity" and Article 15(2) has the Commission encourage benchmarks and measurement methodologies with "metrology and benchmarking authorities"; presumption of conformity flows from harmonised standards under Article 40 (CEN-CENELEC JTC 21). A threshold document without a jurisdiction scope statement will be read as claiming that route. In the US there is no counterpart beyond voluntary NIST AI RMF and a state layer with different content, so the scope statement is also a coverage statement.
